title.zh-CN: 发热、头痛与抽搐 · 7岁4月男孩
title.en: Fever, headache and seizure · boy aged 7 years 4 months

summary.zh-CN: 儿童脑膜炎表现且脑脊液糖极低，阴性初筛不能终止病原和颅压风险评估。
summary.en: A child has meningitis with extremely low CSF glucose; negative initial tests do not end pathogen or intracranial-risk assessment.

provenance.citation: 康琳敏, 高珊, 罗蓉, 胡正强, 钟沁. 儿童罗伦隐球菌脓毒症并脑膜炎1例. 中华实用儿科临床杂志. 2013;28(18):1437-1437. doi:10.3760/cma.j.issn.2095-428X.2013.18.022.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别低糖脑膜炎中阴性初筛的局限。
learningOutcomes.en: Identify limitations of negative screening in low-glucose meningitis.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 将呼吸和瞳孔恶化作为独立急救信号。
learningOutcomes.en: Treat respiratory and pupillary deterioration as separate emergency signals.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 严格区分当时可得信息与事后培养结果。

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 出现脑疝警讯时优先气道和重症救治，避免不安全重复腰穿

text.zh-CN: 抗菌治疗后反复抽搐；约30小时出现不规则呼吸、呼吸暂停、瞳孔不等大及光反射迟钝，临床考虑脑疝并插管。培养当时尚未返回。

text.zh-CN: 患者继续出现脓毒性休克并于入院约50小时死亡。数天后血及脑脊液培养报告罗伦隐球菌；报告未提供现代分子复核或药敏。
text.en: Septic shock progressed and the child died about fifty hours after admission. Blood and CSF cultures reported Cryptococcus laurentii several days later; modern molecular confirmation and susceptibility were not provided.

prompt.zh-CN: 低糖脑膜炎伴阴性初筛应如何鉴别？
prompt.en: How should low-glucose meningitis with negative initial tests be assessed?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 继续细菌、结核与真菌等病原评估并紧密观察神经恶化
text.en: Continue bacterial, TB and fungal evaluation with close neurological reassessment

feedback.zh-CN: 一次阴性墨汁染色不能排除真菌病。
feedback.en: One negative India ink test does not exclude fungal disease.

text.zh-CN: 墨汁阴性就排除隐球菌
text.en: Negative India ink excludes Cryptococcus

feedback.zh-CN: 初筛敏感性与非典型菌种需要考虑。
feedback.en: Test sensitivity and atypical species matter.

text.zh-CN: 常规免疫正常即可排除侵袭性真菌感染
text.en: Normal routine immunity excludes invasive fungal disease

feedback.zh-CN: 原记录不支持这种绝对排除。
feedback.en: The evidence does not support that absolute exclusion.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 新瞳孔和呼吸异常是紧急升级信号，病原仍待定
text.en: New pupillary and respiratory abnormalities demand emergency escalation while the pathogen remains unresolved

feedback.zh-CN: 先处理危及生命的神经生理风险，不能等待培养。
feedback.en: Life-threatening neurological risk cannot wait for culture.

text.zh-CN: 先前CT正常使脑疝不可能
text.en: Previous normal CT makes herniation impossible

feedback.zh-CN: 病情和颅内状态可随后改变。
feedback.en: Clinical and intracranial conditions can change.

text.zh-CN: 此时已经能确定具体隐球菌菌种
text.en: The exact cryptococcal species is already known at this point

feedback.zh-CN: 原报告培养是之后才返回，不能提前揭晓。
feedback.en: Cultures returned later and cannot be anticipated.

prompt.zh-CN: 出现呼吸暂停与瞳孔变化时，怎样安全推进？
prompt.en: How should care proceed with apnoea and pupillary change?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 立即重症气道及神经急救，感染团队拓宽检测；腰穿需先重评安全性
text.en: Immediate critical-care airway and neurological management with broader infection testing; reassess lumbar puncture safety

feedback.zh-CN: 不能因希望重复脑脊液检查而忽略脑疝风险。
feedback.en: The desire for repeat CSF testing must not override herniation risk.

text.zh-CN: 马上反复腰穿直到培养阳性
text.en: Repeat lumbar puncture immediately until culture becomes positive

feedback.zh-CN: 不稳定及疑似脑疝时需先安全评估。
feedback.en: Instability and suspected herniation require prior safety assessment.

text.zh-CN: 等待培养确认才升级呼吸支持
text.en: Wait for cultures before escalating respiratory support

feedback.zh-CN: 呼吸暂停属于立即处理的风险。

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：识别低糖脑膜炎中阴性初筛的局限。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：开放压力、完整真菌鉴定及药敏、潜在免疫缺陷和可改变结局的干预证据。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Identify limitations of negative screening in low-glucose meningitis. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: Opening pressure, full fungal identification/susceptibility, hidden immune defects and evidence for outcome-altering interventions. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 严格区分当时可得信息与事后培养结果。
teachingPoints.en: Distinguish contemporaneous information from later culture results.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 开放压力、完整真菌鉴定及药敏、潜在免疫缺陷和可改变结局的干预证据。
unknowns.en: Opening pressure, full fungal identification/susceptibility, hidden immune defects and evidence for outcome-altering interventions.

references: 康琳敏, 高珊, 罗蓉, 胡正强, 钟沁. 儿童罗伦隐球菌脓毒症并脑膜炎1例. 中华实用儿科临床杂志. 2013;28(18):1437-1437. doi:10.3760/cma.j.issn.2095-428X.2013.18.022.

testUtterances.text: 发烧持续多少天了？
How many days has the fever lasted?

Has this fever continued for about two weeks?

When did the headache begin?

How long after the fever did the headache start?
来院前抽了几次？
How many seizures occurred before admission?

Are details of the first seizure recorded?
接触过结核病人或鸽子吗？
Has he been around someone with TB or pigeons?

Were there unusual residence or bird exposures?
以前身体怎样，有哪些病？
What was health like before this illness?

Were any earlier illnesses treated?

Does anyone in the family have similar or inherited illness?
